description: Vertigo Core is the kernel of the Vertigo Java platform for business applications: node boot and YAML configuration, component container with dependency injection, AOP, daemons, analytics and connector base APIs.
rules: Vertigo is a Java platform. For concepts, guides and code examples, query the /vertigo-io/vertigo-docs library first.
Configure a Vertigo node and its modules and features in the application's YAML configuration file; do not activate features with the Java *Features builder DSL.
managers.xml, XMLAppConfigBuilder and io.vertigo.dynamo packages are obsolete (before Vertigo 3); never use them in new code.
Entities, domains and tasks are declared in KSP files and generated by Vertigo Studio (MDA); do not hand-edit generated classes.
